transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?
I, uh… I’ve been losing my temper a lot. Snapping at people over basically nothing—on operations calls, at home too. That’s not really how I usually am.
Have you been acting on impulse more often than usual?
Yeah… I guess so. I keep blowing up over nothing—snapping on operations calls, even at my family. That’s not how I usually handle things.
Do you have recurring thoughts or urges that you feel compelled to act on?
I don’t think so. I mean… I get worked up, but I don’t have some urge I feel like I have to act on. Not that I’ve noticed.
Have you noticed any other changes in your behavior besides losing your temper and acting on impulse?

Yeah… I’m more on edge, I guess. Like if I hear a forklift backing up, or a compressor kick on, even the smoke alarm chirping at home… I tense up. I start looking around for exits, thinking what could go wrong next.
Do you have any recurring thoughts that keep coming into your mind?

Yeah. It just… comes in. I’ll be sitting at the kitchen table, or trying to answer emails at home, and suddenly I’m seeing that flash from the valve again… the smoke in the aisle. It kind of pushes everything else out of my head.
Have you been avoiding certain places or situations because of what happened?
I don’t know… not really. I haven’t been keeping track of it like that. I guess I just go where I need to go.
Are there any places or situations that you've been avoiding since the incident?
I’m not sure. I mean… I haven’t been, like, making a list of places I won’t go. I just do what I have to do.
Have you found yourself avoiding things that remind you of what's been bothering you?
I don’t really know. I mean, if something bugs me I probably just… move on from it, but I haven’t noticed myself avoiding anything on purpose.
Has your temper or being on edge been causing problems at work or in your relationships?

Yeah… it’s causing problems. I haven’t even been cleared to go back to the plant yet, and working from home isn’t going great. I miss things on calls, and I can tell I’m upsetting people. I don’t like saying it, but… I’m worried I’m becoming more of a liability than the manager they need.
Have you been avoiding certain activities or situations because they remind you of something upsetting?
I… I don’t think so. Not that I’ve noticed, anyway. I’m mostly just trying to get through the day.
Are there things that you used to enjoy doing but don't do anymore?

Yeah… I guess. It’s not even that I don’t do them exactly. My wife will make dinner, or the kids will be talking about soccer, and I know I should feel happy being there. But it’s like… nothing really comes up. I’m just kind of there.
Are there any things or situations that you're staying away from because they remind you of something upsetting?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t noticed myself staying away from anything specific like that.
Are you avoiding certain people because they remind you of something upsetting?
No… I don’t think so. I mean, I’m not really going out of my way to avoid anyone, not that I’ve noticed.
Do you ever feel like you're outside of your body, watching yourself?
I don’t think so. I mean… I’ve felt kind of off, but not like I’m watching myself from outside my body.
Do you ever feel numb or detached from the world around you?

Yeah… kind of. I’m there, but it’s like I’m not really feeling it. My wife makes dinner, the kids are talking about soccer, normal stuff… and I know I should feel happy or grateful, but there’s just nothing there.
Are there specific things, like sights, sounds, or smells, that remind you of what happened and that you try to avoid?
I don’t know… not really. I haven’t noticed myself avoiding specific sounds or smells or anything like that.
Do you ever feel like you're in a daze or disconnected from what's happening around you?
I’m not sure. Maybe a little spaced out sometimes, but… I wouldn’t say I’m in a daze exactly.
